title: Paying the optional 3 XP additional cost does not exempt the controller from the kill.
expected: Safety Inspector (riftbound-cards/src/cards/unl/safety-inspector.ts) has no hand-authored abilities, so enrich-cards.ts:30 derives them from parseAbilities(rulesText). Running the parser on the card text yields only `{type:"kill", player:"each", target:{type:"unit"}}` on play-self — the sentence "If you paid my additional cost, you don't kill a unit this way" is silently dropped (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-damage.ts:144-154 matches "Each player must kill one of their units" and returns a bare target with no controller and no paid-additional-cost conditional). In the engine, kill.ts:97-105 `isEachPlayersOwn` requires `target.controller === "friendly"`, so this effect falls through to the plain path kill.ts:179 `killUnits(getTargetIds(...))`, which resolves `{type:"unit"}` against all units of both players -> pendingChoice for player-1 with [Recruit(p1), Safety Inspector(p1), Mech(p2)], remaining:1, exactly as observed. Nothing in kill.ts or the trigger path consults triggerEvent.paidAdditionalCost to exempt the controller (the only consumer, trigger-runner.ts:308, evaluates a `paid-additional-cost` condition the parser never emitted). Contrast ogn-209-298 (cull-the-weak.ts) which hand-authors `controller:"friendly"` to hit the per-player path.
observed: Trigger went on chain with triggerEvent.paidAdditionalCost:true but the effect was identical: pendingChoice for player-1 with options [Recruit(p1), Safety Inspector(p1), Mech(p2)], remaining:1 — player-1's own units still offered/required; no automatic kill for player-2.
